title: Risk-Based Supervision, Colleges and Cross-Border Cooperation
summary: Designing a risk-based supervisory approach to CASPs, monitoring and inspecting firms between engagements, and managing passporting, home–host responsibilities and colleges with other authorities.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: Designing a risk-based supervisory approach to CASPs, monitoring and inspecting firms between engagements, and managing passporting, home–host responsibilities and colleges with other authorities.
Learning Objectives: Prioritise CASPs by impact and probability of harm and set escalation triggers
Plan and conduct inspections that test practice rather than documentation
Manage home and host responsibilities and information exchange across borders
Syllabus: Firm risk assessment, supervisory planning and early warning signals
Inspection methods: data requests, interviews, walkthroughs and customer journeys
Passport notifications, reverse solicitation and host authority powers
Colleges, ESMA convergence tools and peer reviews
Intended Audience: Authorisation, supervision and inspection staff new to crypto-asset service providers and token issuers
AML/CFT, market integrity, payments and enforcement specialists who need a working grasp of MiCA
Managers and policy staff who need an overview before committing teams to deeper training
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some experience of authorising or supervising financial firms is helpful. No technical background in blockchain is required.
Core Reading: Regulation (EU) 2023/1113 on information accompanying transfers of funds and certain crypto-assets (Transfer of Funds Regulation)
FSB, High-level Recommendations for the Regulation, Supervision and Oversight of Crypto-Asset Activities and Markets (2023)
FATF, Updated Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Virtual Assets and Virtual Asset Service Providers (2021)
